speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with a breast mass; to begin my evaluation, how long have you noticed this lump, and has it changed in size or shape recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a concerning progression; has the mass been accompanied by skin changes like dimpling, redness, or nipple retraction? REQUEST TEST: Mammography and Ultrasound of the left breast.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Mammography Findings: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast; Breast Examination: No skin changes, nipple retraction, or discharge; Biopsy Microscopic Description: Image shows leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes Tumor (likely Benign or Borderline based on smooth polylobulated morphology and leaf-like structures with stromal overgrowth).
